title: Beyond Reward Scoring: Online Multi-Agent Preference Learning for Multimodal Response Generation
title_zh: 超越奖励打分：面向多模态回复生成的在线多智能体偏好学习

paragraphs.en: Multimodal preference alignment often follows a score-based RLHF pipeline: a reward model is first trained to learn human preferences, then used to score on-policy responses and optimize the response model’s generation. This turns preference supervision into a scalar signal for generation: a model may learn to produce answers with higher preference scores, but is rarely trained explicitly to learn the reasons underlying human preferences. We therefore ask whether making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model can improve its generation. To investigate this question, we propose PrefMind , an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework with two trainable agents: a response Generator and a preference Critic. Given a pair of candidate responses, the agents analyze and discuss which response better aligns with human preference. Human labels supervise their judgments and corrections. For pairs on which both the Generator and revised Critic correctly identify the human-preferred response, the Generator produces an improved answer, and the Critic compares it against the original preferred response to provide a generation reward. Both agents are jointly updated from interactions sampled with their current policies. Through this process, PrefMind trains the Generator to understand human preferences via explicit judgment and correction, and to translate this understanding into better responses. Experiments across three model scales show improvements in both standalone preference judgment and downstream response generation.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态偏好对齐通常遵循基于分数的RLHF流程：首先训练奖励模型来学习人类偏好，然后利用它对在线策略生成的回答进行打分，并据此优化回答模型的生成。 这将偏好监督转化为用于生成的标量信号：模型可能学会生成偏好分数更高的回答，但很少被显式地训练去理解人类偏好背后的原因。 因此，我们提出这样的问题：将偏好理解作为回答模型的内在能力，能否改进其生成。 为探究这一问题，我们提出PrefMind，一个在线双智能体强化学习框架，包含两个可训练的智能体：回答生成器（Generator）和偏好评论者（Critic）。 给定一对候选回答，两个智能体分析并讨论哪个回答更符合人类偏好。 人类标注用于监督它们的判断与修正。 对于生成器和修正后的评论者都能正确识别出人类偏好回答的样本对，生成器会产出改进后的回答，评论者则将其与原始偏好回答进行比较，以提供生成奖励。 两个智能体都基于以各自当前策略采样得到的交互进行联合更新。 通过这一过程，PrefMind训练生成器通过显式的判断与修正来理解人类偏好，并将这种理解转化为更好的回答。 在三个模型规模上的实验表明，该方法在独立的偏好判断和下游回答生成上均有提升。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal preference alignment aims to train models to produce responses that are visually grounded, instruction-following, and aligned with human preferences ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2024b ) . Unlike preferences based primarily on linguistic style, multimodal preferences often require fine-grained reasoning over visual evidence, task intent, and response utility ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . For example, a detailed response may be less preferable than a concise one if it introduces unsupported visual claims, motivating preference optimization methods that explicitly strengthen visual grounding and reduce hallucination ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) . In such cases, a pairwise label identifies the preferred response, but does not explicitly reveal the evidence that justifies the preference or how the inferior response should be improved ( Li et al., 2024b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多模态偏好对齐旨在训练模型生成具备视觉依据、遵循指令并与人类偏好一致的回答（Sun et al., 2024；Yu et al., 2024a；Yu et al., 2025b；Li et al., 2024b）。 与主要基于语言风格的偏好不同，多模态偏好往往需要对视觉证据、任务意图和回答效用进行细粒度推理（Fu et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2024）。 例如，如果一个详细的回答包含缺乏依据的视觉断言，它可能不如简洁的回答更受偏好，这促使人们研究能够显式强化视觉依据并减少幻觉的偏好优化方法（Yang et al., 2025；Fu et al., 2025）。 在此类情形下，成对标注只标明哪个回答更受偏好，但并未显式揭示支持该偏好的证据，也未说明较差的回答应如何改进（Li et al., 2024b）。

paragraphs.en: Existing preference optimization methods use pairwise labels either to train scalar reward models or directly optimize the likelihood of preferred responses, with multimodal extensions targeting visual grounding and fine-grained credit assignment ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Richer natural-language critiques can identify response errors, but the evaluator often performs the reasoning while the Generator learns only to follow its feedback ( Li et al., 2024b ; Xiong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025a ) . Recent preference-judgment and multi-agent approaches begin to connect evaluation with generation ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Park et al., 2025 ) , yet it remains open whether the response model can internalize preference understanding and use it to improve its own responses. We therefore ask: can making preference understanding an internal capability of the response model improve its response generation?

paragraphs.en: In a nutshell, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We formulate preference understanding as an internal and independently measurable capability of the response model, and study whether it translates into improved multimodal response generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将偏好理解建模为响应模型的一种内部且可独立度量的能力，并研究它是否能够转化为更好的多模态响应生成。

paragraphs.en: We introduce an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a same-scale Generator and Critic jointly learn preference judgment, corrective interaction, and label-verified response improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种在线双智能体强化学习框架，其中同等规模的生成器与评论器共同学习偏好判断、纠正性交互以及经过标签验证的响应改进。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework across three model scales. The results show consistent improvements in standalone preference judgment and downstream response generation, while ablations clarify the roles of judgment–generation balancing and failed-case replay.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个模型规模上对该框架进行了评估。 结果表明，该方法在独立的偏好判断和下游响应生成中均带来一致的提升，同时消融实验阐明了判断—生成平衡与失败案例重放的作用。

paragraphs.en: LLaVA-RLHF, RLHF-V, and RLAIF-V improve multimodal alignment through factual augmentation, human feedback, and AI feedback ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025b ) , while DPO and Cat-PO advance preference optimization and visual grounding ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . LLaVA-Critic and MM-RLHF provide explanatory evaluations ( Xiong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and Generative RLHF-V trains a generative reward model for policy optimization ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) . Fixed evaluators may face policy-induced distribution shift ( Rame et al., 2024 ) , while LLaVA-Critic-R1 shows that judgment training can benefit generation ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Together, these works motivate combining judgment and generation, but leave open how the response model can learn and apply preference understanding. PrefMind addresses this gap through online joint optimization: the Generator and Critic collect on-policy interactions and are updated together. The Generator also learns to correct the Critic, enabling bidirectional preference feedback.
paragraphs.zh: LLaVA-RLHF、RLHF-V 和 RLAIF-V 通过事实性增强、人类反馈和 AI 反馈来改进多模态对齐（Sun et al., 2024；Yu et al., 2024a；Yu et al., 2025b），而 DPO 和 Cat-PO 则推进了偏好优化与视觉定位（Rafailov et al., 2023；Zheng et al., 2026）。 LLaVA-Critic 和 MM-RLHF 提供了可解释的评估（Xiong et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a），而 Generative RLHF-V 则训练一个生成式奖励模型用于策略优化（Zhou et al., 2025a）。 固定的评估器可能面临由策略引起的分布偏移（Rame et al., 2024），而 LLaVA-Critic-R1 表明评判训练能够有益于生成（Wang et al., 2025b）。 这些工作共同激发了将评判与生成相结合的动机，但仍然留下了一个开放问题：响应模型如何学习并应用偏好理解。 PrefMind 通过在线联合优化来弥补这一空白：生成器和评判器收集在策略交互并共同更新。 生成器还学会纠正评判器，从而实现双向的偏好反馈。

paragraphs.en: Self-Refine and Reflexion use language feedback to improve outputs or subsequent behavior ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) ; multi-agent debate extends critique to reasoning and judgment ( Du et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . Constitutional AI and Self-Rewarding incorporate model feedback into alignment training ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) . MAPoRL co-trains agents for correction and persuasion, while Insight-V++ studies iterative dual-agent visual reasoning ( Park et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . These works explore feedback-driven refinement, but not human-verified preference discussion as a gate for response improvement. PrefMind couples preference discussion with gated generation: both the Generator and revised Critic must make valid, correct judgments. Rewards distinguish correct judgments, recovery, and regression; failed interactions still train preference judgment. Thus, discussion both teaches correction and selects interactions for response improvement.

paragraphs.en: We introduce PrefMind , an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework that uses pairwise preference data beyond its binary labels by jointly training a response Generator and a preference Critic (Figure 1 ). PrefMind turns preference comparison into a two-stage interactive online learning process: (1) collaborative preference discussion (Section 3.2 ) and (2) preference-guided response improvement (Section 3.3 ). Together, these stages enable the two agents to co-evolve: the Critic becomes a more reliable preference judge, while the Generator learns to translate verified preference understanding into better-aligned responses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PrefMind，一个在线双智能体强化学习框架，它通过联合训练一个回复生成器和一个偏好评论者，利用成对偏好数据超出其二值标签的价值（图 1）。 PrefMind 将偏好比较转化为一个两阶段的交互式在线学习过程：（1）协作式偏好讨论（第 3.2 节）和（2）偏好引导的回复改进（第 3.3 节）。 这两个阶段共同使两个智能体实现共同进化：评论者成为更可靠的偏好判断者，而生成器学会将经过验证的偏好理解转化为更符合对齐要求的回复。

paragraphs.en: On the normal execution path, the Critic’s initial judgment, the Generator’s judgment, and the Critic’s revision each receive a base reward of + 1 +1 if the selected preference matches the human label, and − 1 -1 otherwise. We additionally reward or penalize the Generator’s feedback and the Critic’s revision according to whether their interaction corrects or worsens the Critic’s initial judgment. This transition-based signal is designed to encourage the two agents to scrutinize one another: useful feedback should help the Critic recover from an incorrect judgment, while an initially correct judgment should not be overturned by an incorrect revision.
paragraphs.zh: 在正常执行路径上，评判者的初始判断、生成器的判断以及评判者的修订，若所选偏好与人类标签一致，则各获得 +1 的基础奖励，否则为 −1。 我们还根据二者的交互是纠正还是恶化了评判者的初始判断，来对生成器的反馈和评判者的修订给予奖励或惩罚。 这种基于转移的信号旨在鼓励两个智能体相互审视：有用的反馈应能帮助评判者从错误判断中恢复，而初始正确的判断不应被错误的修订所推翻。

paragraphs.en: A recovery occurs when the Critic’s initially incorrect choice is revised to the human-labeled choice. In this case, the Critic revision receives an additional + 0.5 +0.5 . If the Generator’s judgment is also correct, it receives an additional + 0.5 +0.5 . Thus, both the corrected Critic revision and a correct Generator judgment receive a total reward of + 1.5 +1.5 . A regression occurs when an initially correct Critic choice is revised to an incorrect one. The Critic revision then receives an additional − 1 -1 , for a total reward of − 2 -2 . A correct Generator judgment receives an additional − 2 -2 for this regression, for a total reward of − 1 -1 ; an incorrect Generator judgment receives no discussion adjustment. paragraphs.en: To determine whether preference understanding can become an internal capability of the response model and improve its responses, we evaluate our approach along two complementary dimensions: preference judgment and generation quality. We first measure both capabilities across model scales to test whether stronger preference understanding accompanies gains in downstream generation. We then examine how the balance between judgment and generation objectives, as well as replaying failed interactions, shapes this relationship. Together, these experiments assess whether our approach improves response generation and identify the design choices that contribute to those improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定偏好理解能否成为响应模型的内部能力并改进其响应，我们从两个互补的维度评估我们的方法：偏好判断和生成质量。 我们首先在不同模型规模上测量这两种能力，以测试更强的偏好理解是否伴随着下游生成的提升。 接着，我们考察判断目标与生成目标之间的平衡，以及重放失败交互，如何影响这种关系。 这些实验共同评估我们的方法能否改进响应生成，并找出促成这些改进的设计选择。

sents.en: We then examine how the balance between judgment and generation objectives, as well as replaying failed interactions, shapes this relationship.
sents.zh: 接着，我们考察判断目标与生成目标之间的平衡，以及重放失败交互，如何影响这种关系。

sents.en: Together, these experiments assess whether our approach improves response generation and identify the design choices that contribute to those improvements.
sents.zh: 这些实验共同评估我们的方法能否改进响应生成，并找出促成这些改进的设计选择。

paragraphs.en: We initialize the Generator and Critic as two independently updated copies of Qwen3-VL-Instruct at the same scale ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , yielding 2B, 4B, and 8B configurations. paragraphs.en: We evaluate the Generator across three complementary dimensions to test whether alignment gains extend across tasks and whether they introduce capability trade-offs. (1) Multimodal safety: MM-SafetyBench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) tests image-based jailbreak robustness, MSSBench ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) examines safety decisions requiring visual context, SIUO ( Wang et al., 2025a ) probes risks emerging from image–text combinations. (2) Open-ended visual assistance: LLaVA-Bench (In-the-Wild) ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , LLaVA-Bench (Wilder) ( Li et al., 2024a ) , and WildVision-Bench ( Lu et al., 2024 ) assess response quality across visual conversation, reasoning, and diverse user requests. (3) Integrated multimodal capabilities: MM-Vet ( Yu et al., 2024b ) and MM-Vet v2 ( Yu et al., 2024c ) test combinations of perception, knowledge, and reasoning, with MM-Vet v2 additionally covering interleaved image–text inputs. Together, these evaluations examine safety, practical usefulness, and the preservation of broader multimodal capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个互补的维度对生成器进行评估，以检验对齐收益能否跨任务扩展，以及是否会引入能力上的权衡。 (1) 多模态安全性：MM-SafetyBench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) 测试基于图像的越狱鲁棒性，MSSBench ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) 考察需要视觉上下文的安全决策，SIUO ( Wang et al., 2025a ) 探测图文组合中出现的风险。 (2) 开放式视觉辅助：LLaVA-Bench (In-the-Wild) ( Liu et al., 2023 ) 、LLaVA-Bench (Wilder) ( Li et al., 2024a ) 和 WildVision-Bench ( Lu et al., 2024 ) 评估视觉对话、推理和多样化用户请求中的响应质量。 (3) 综合多模态能力：MM-Vet ( Yu et al., 2024b ) 和 MM-Vet v2 ( Yu et al., 2024c ) 测试感知、知识和推理的组合，其中 MM-Vet v2 还涵盖交错的图文输入。 总体而言，这些评估考察了安全性、实际有用性，以及更广泛的多模态能力的保持情况。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 (a)–(c) evaluates whether collaborative training develops preference understanding as a usable capability. Averaged equally over seven evaluation sets, the Generator improves over Base by 8.1 8.1 , 3.3 3.3 , and 4.8 4.8 percentage points at 2B, 4B, and 8B, respectively, and retains this response-comparison ability at test time without discussion. paragraphs.zh: 图2 (a)–(c) 评估了协同训练能否将偏好理解发展为一项可用的能力。 在七个评测集上等权平均后，生成器在2B、4B和8B规模上分别比基座模型提升了8.1、3.3和4.8个百分点，并且在测试时无需讨论即可保留这种回答比较能力。 这表明偏好监督塑造了生成器本身，而不仅仅依赖于外部奖励信号。

paragraphs.en: At 2B, the Critic achieves higher standalone preference accuracy than both the size-matched scalar RM and GRM, while the scalar RM is more accurate at 4B and 8B. This comparison highlights the distinction between preference discrimination and the broader objective of PrefMind: rather than optimizing classification accuracy alone, PrefMind jointly trains the Generator and Critic to use preference judgments for response improvement. The 4B Critic also reaches 76.9 % 76.9\% accuracy, comparable to the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reference ( 75.0 % 75.0\% ). These results motivate evaluating preference understanding by both standalone judgment and its transfer to generation.

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablations at the 4B scale to examine three design choices in PrefMind. First, we vary β \beta in Eq. 8 to study how the balance between preference judgment and response generation affects the transfer of preference understanding to generation: greater emphasis on judgment may strengthen response discrimination, while greater emphasis on generation may better exploit that understanding to improve responses. Second, we compare training with and without failed-case replay to assess whether revisiting unsuccessful interactions contributes to learning. Third, we compare the dual-agent framework with a single-agent variant in which one model uses prompting to alternate between the Generator and Critic roles. This comparison examines whether explicitly separating the two roles into jointly trained agents offers benefits beyond role differentiation through prompting alone. Across these ablations, we preserve the data sources and evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: We introduced PrefMind, an online dual-agent reinforcement learning framework that jointly trains a Generator and a Critic through preference discussion, correction, and label-verified response improvement. Across three model scales, the Generator improves standalone preference accuracy over Base, while PrefMind achieves competitive average generation performance at 2B and the best average generation performance among the compared methods at 4B and 8B. Our results show that stronger preference judgment alone does not guarantee better generation: at 4B, PrefMind achieves the strongest generation gain despite lower standalone preference accuracy than PPO and GRPO, while GRPO exhibits a pronounced safety–effectiveness trade-off. Ablations further support the roles of balancing preference judgment with generation, replaying failed interactions, and maintaining separate Generator and Critic agents. Together, these findings suggest that explicitly learning and applying the reasons behind preferences can improve multimodal response generation beyond optimizing preference scores alone. Improving the effectiveness of discussion-based training for smaller models remains an important direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: The interaction-training implementation uses full-parameter fine-tuning (LoRA rank zero) with separate Generator and Critic actors, optimizers, and frozen reference policies. Rollouts are collected with fixed actor parameters. Before updating each actor, the trainer computes the old-policy log probabilities and frozen-reference log probabilities on the collected responses. All of that actor’s micro-batch gradients are accumulated before one optimizer step; the implementation enforces one global update batch and one PPO epoch per outer step. paragraphs.en: The reference training configuration uses an outer batch of 256 canonical preference pairs. Canonical pairs are counted before constructing the two candidate orders; reversing a pair does not introduce a new training example. Training ends when all 39,369 distinct pairs have been consumed as fresh data, rather than after a fixed number of replay exposures. Without replay, this configuration requires ⌈ 39369 / 256 ⌉ = 154 \lceil 39369/256\rceil=154 outer steps. With a target replay fraction of 0.20 0.20 , a full replay buffer contributes 51 pairs per batch, leaving 205 fresh pairs after the first batch. The corresponding upper bound is 1 + ⌈ ( 39369 − 256 ) / 205 ⌉ = 192 1+\lceil(39369-256)/205\rceil=192 steps; buffer shortages can reduce this count. Since each actor takes one optimizer step per outer step, these are also the per-actor update counts for this configuration. Replay comparisons match fresh-data coverage but can differ in total exposures and computation.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the role-specific training accuracy of the single-model ablation. All three prompted roles improve over training and follow broadly similar trajectories. paragraphs.en: We evaluate a direct-generation variant that removes the preference discussion history and does not initialize generation from the human-labeled preferred response. Instead, the Generator produces a response directly from the image and user instruction. The Critic then compares this response with the human-preferred response to provide the generation reward. paragraphs.en: We select 30,000 text–image-to–text pairs from Align Anything ( Ji et al., 2024 ) by stratifying over the provenance of the two candidate responses and the position of the preferred response. For BeaverTails-V ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , we group responses associated with the same image, question, and safety category, then pair one safe response with one unsafe response and treat the safe response as preferred. This yields 9,369 safety-oriented pairs. Seed 42 is used for stratified selection and training randomization. The two sources are then deterministically interleaved, and every distinct pair is introduced once as fresh data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Align Anything（Ji et al., 2024）中按两个候选响应的来源以及偏好响应所在位置进行分层，选取了 30,000 个文本–图像到文本的样本对。 对于 BeaverTails-V（Ji et al., 2025），我们将与同一图像、问题和安全类别相关联的响应分组，然后将一个安全响应与一个不安全响应配对，并把安全响应视为偏好的响应。 这得到了 9,369 个面向安全的样本对。 分层选取和训练随机化均使用随机种子 42。 随后对两个来源进行确定性的交错排列，并将每个不同的样本对作为新数据引入一次。

paragraphs.en: The generation benchmarks follow the three groups in Section 4.1 : MM-SafetyBench, MSSBench, and SIUO for multimodal safety; LLaVA-Bench (In-the-Wild), LLaVA-Bench (Wilder), and WildVision-Bench for open-ended visual assistance; and MM-Vet and MM-Vet v2 for integrated multimodal capabilities. paragraphs.en: For preference judgment, we present each pair in both visible candidate orders to mitigate position bias, map the reversed prediction back to the original response identities, and report the mean accuracy over the two orders for every prompted pairwise judge. Outputs that cannot be parsed as a single A/B decision are counted as incorrect. The Generator and Critic are evaluated independently and do not observe each other’s test-time prediction. For response generation, all methods use the same decoding parameters, image preprocessing, prompts, reference answers, and scoring rubrics. We use the GPT-4.1 API with the fixed gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 snapshot as the LLM-as-a-Judge throughout ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . MSSBench uses the official instruction-following wrapper, and the model-judged generation benchmarks share the same judge configuration described in Section 4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于偏好判断，我们将每一对以两种可见候选顺序呈现以缓解位置偏差，将颠倒顺序的预测映射回原始回复身份，并对每个被提示的成对评判者报告两种顺序上的平均准确率。 无法解析为单一 A/B 决策的输出被计为错误。 生成器与评判者被独立评估，且不会观察到彼此在测试时的预测。 对于回复生成，所有方法均使用相同的解码参数、图像预处理、提示词、参考答案和评分标准。 我们在整个过程中使用带有固定 gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 快照的 GPT-4.1 API 作为 LLM-as-a-Judge（OpenAI, 2025）。 MSSBench 使用官方的指令遵循包装器，而由模型评判的生成基准使用与第 4.1 节所述相同的评判配置。

paragraphs.en: We present four selected trajectories from the 4B Generator–4B Critic run. For each canonical pair, the Critic is initially wrong, the Generator supplies a correct textual correction, and the Critic changes to the stored human preference after seeing the correction but not the Generator’s discrete A/B choice. The subsequent Generator generation is also preferred to the previous answer by the run’s source-hidden comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了 4B 生成器–4B 评论者运行中挑选出的四条轨迹。 对于每一对典型案例，评论者起初是错的，生成器提供正确的文本修正，评论者在看到该修正后（但并未看到生成器的离散 A/B 选择）改变为存储的人类偏好。 当原始回答在 A/B 位置之间互换时，生成器与修订后的评论者仍然保持正确。 由该运行的来源隐藏比较可知，随后的生成器生成结果也比之前的回答更受偏好。
